name: modern-web-guidance-src
one_liner: A reference library that teaches AI coding assistants the modern, correct way to build websites so they stop writing outdated, bloated code from old tutorials.
buyer: No direct buyer — this is purely a developer-tooling reference maintained by browser vendors, not something a non-technical business would pay for on its own.
business_use_cases: A web development agency installs it so every project its AI coding agents touch defaults to modern, accessible, performant code, reducing cleanup time on client sites.
A coding bootcamp or course creator uses its curated guides as up-to-date teaching material instead of outdated blog tutorials.
A performance-consulting freelancer runs its legacy-scan command as a quick first pass before quoting a website optimization job.

money_ideas.idea: Fold it into a paid 'website modernization audit' service for agencies using it to quote cleanup work

steal_this: This is a developer tool, not a product — the honest weekend move is to run its legacy-scan on a few local businesses' outdated sites and pitch them a flat-fee modernization quote using the findings.
